result.instructions: Tools for Starshipit, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders are waiting to be shipped right now?"; "Where is the parcel for order number 1042 right now?"; "What are the shipping rates to Auckland for a 2kg parcel?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Starshipit data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run starshipit_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run starshipit_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run starshipit_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. starshipit_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: starshipit_list_unshipped_orders
tools.title: List unshipped orders
tools.description: List unshipped (new, not yet printed) orders with full details: addresses, items, packages, carrier. By default only orders updated in the last 24 hours; use since_order_date / since_last_updated to look further back. ids_only=true returns just the order ids. GET /api/orders/unshipped.

since_order_date.description: Only orders created after this UTC date-time (RFC 3339).

since_last_updated.description: Only orders updated after this UTC date-time (RFC 3339).

ids_only.description: Return only the unshipped order ids.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_list_shipped_orders
tools.title: List shipped orders
tools.description: List shipped orders (label printed) with tracking number, tracking status, carrier, manifest and shipped date. By default only orders updated in the last 24 hours; use since_last_updated to look further back. Label files are not returned. GET /api/orders/shipped.

since_last_updated.description: Only orders updated after this UTC date-time (RFC 3339).

ids_only.description: Return only the shipped order ids.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_list_printed_orders
tools.title: List printed or unmanifested orders
tools.description: List orders whose label was recently printed, or printed but not yet manifested, with tracking numbers. GET /api/orders/shipments.

since_created_date.description: Only shipments created after this UTC date-time (RFC 3339).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_list_delivered_orders
tools.title: List delivered orders by reference
tools.description: List delivered orders that carry a given order reference (the customer reference), with full order details. GET /api/orders/delivered.

order_ref.description: The order reference to look for.

tools.name: starshipit_orders_summary
tools.title: Orders summary by status
tools.description: A compact list of orders in one status (new, printed, shipped, archived) with contact, country, carrier, weight, manifest and dates, plus account-wide counts (unprinted, printed, shipped, archived, invalid addresses, returns). Supports filters and sorting. GET /api/orders/summary.

filter.description: Filter string COLUMN:::VALUE, several separated by commas, e.g. `Order:::1419,State:::NSW` or `Source:::Shopify`. Columns: Order, Name, Address (valid), Date (>=MAY 2024), Source, State, Country, Carrier, Service, Status, SKU, SingleSKU, Writeback, Weight (>=5), ShippingMethod, ShippingDescription, Tag. Prefix a column with ! to negate (!Country:::Australia).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search orders by order number, tracking number, customer reference or recipient name (phrase), optionally limited to unshipped or shipped orders. Returns id, number, date, name, carrier, tracking number and country. GET /api/orders/search.

phrase.description: Search text, e.g. a name, order number or tracking number.

fields.description: Which field to search (default All: order number, tracking number, reference, name).

status.description: Limit to unshipped or shipped orders (default All).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_get_order
tools.title: Get one order
tools.description: One order by Starshipit order_id or by the order_number from the source platform. Use include to add sections (Items, Packages, Events, Metadatas, Shipping_Price, ...). Status defaults to Unshipped in Starshipit, so pass status=Shipped or Printed for orders already printed. Label files are not returned. GET /api/orders?order_id= or ?order_number=.

order_number.description: Order number from the source platform, e.g. #1234.

status.description: Order status to look in (Starshipit default: Unshipped).

tools.name: starshipit_list_orders
tools.title: List orders with filters
tools.description: List full order details for one status (Unshipped by default, or Shipped / Printed), narrowed by a filter such as `Order:::1419,Country:::Australia` and sorted. Heavier than the summary: use starshipit_orders_summary for overviews. Label files are not returned. GET /api/orders (no id).

filter.description: Filter string COLUMN:::VALUE, several separated by commas, e.g. `Order:::1419,State:::NSW` or `Source:::Shopify`. Columns: Order, Name, Address (valid), Date (>=MAY 2024), Source, State, Country, Carrier, Service, Status, SKU, SingleSKU, Writeback, Weight (>=5), ShippingMethod, ShippingDescription, Tag. Prefix a column with ! to negate (!Country:::Australia).

page_number.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_track_shipment
tools.title: Track a shipment
tools.description: Tracking details for a shipped order, by tracking number or by order number: status, carrier, tracking URL, shipment date and the carrier's tracking events. GET /api/track.

order_number.description: Order number from the source platform.

tools.name: starshipit_get_rates
tools.title: Quote shipping rates
tools.description: QUOTE ONLY: shipping rates (service name, code, price) for a destination and parcels from the couriers enabled in the account. Nothing is purchased, created or printed. The sender defaults to the account's pickup address. Needs at least one enabled courier. POST /api/rates.

country_code.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. AU, NZ, US.

packages.description: The parcels (weight in kg, dimensions in metres).

sender.description: Sender address; omitted = the account's pickup address.

country_code.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. AU, NZ, US.

currency.description: Currency code for the order value, e.g. AUD.

tools.name: starshipit_list_delivery_services
tools.title: List delivery services
tools.description: QUOTE ONLY: the carrier delivery services available for a shipment (carrier, service name and code) and, with include_pricing, their prices and service options. Nothing is purchased, created or printed. POST /api/deliveryservices.

country_code.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. AU, NZ, US.

packages.description: The parcels (weight in kg, dimensions in metres).

sender.description: Sender address; omitted = the account's pickup address.

country_code.description: 2-letter country code, e.g. AU, NZ, US.

tools.name: starshipit_list_address_book
tools.title: List address book
tools.description: List contacts in the account's address book (name, company, address, phone, email), sorted by a column. GET /api/addressbook/filtered.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_list_manifests
tools.title: List manifests
tools.description: List manifests already submitted to carriers (newest first): number, date, carrier, package and consignment counts. Read only; manifesting is not available here. GET /api/manifests.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_list_products
tools.title: List product catalogue
tools.description: List Product Catalogue records (SKU, title, weight, dimensions, HS code, bin location, price), optionally searching by SKU or title. GET /api/products.

search_term.description: Search text for SKU or title.

page_number.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_list_tags
tools.title: List order tags
tools.description: List the account's user-defined order tags, optionally filtered by tag name. GET /api/tags.

page_number.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_list_pickups
tools.title: List booked pickups
tools.description: List courier pickups already booked for the account. Read only; booking a pickup is not available here. GET /api/pickup.

page_number.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: starshipit_create_order
tools.title: Create an unshipped order
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE new UNSHIPPED order in Starshipit (order number, destination, optional items, parcels, sender). No label is printed, no shipment is booked and no postage is bought; staff still print the label in Starshipit. Not idempotent: creating the same order_number twice may create a duplicate, so check with starshipit_search_orders first. Starshipit rules configured in the account (carrier selection, validation) may run on the new order. POST /api/orders.

order_number.description: Order number from the source system (max 50 chars).

shipping_method.description: Delivery method name, e.g. Express Shipping.

carrier.description: Starshipit carrier code, e.g. AusPost (optional; rules may choose one).

carrier_service_code.description: Carrier service code from a rates quote, e.g. 7B05.

return_order.description: true = a return order (only the return label will be generated later).

currency.description: Currency code of the item values, e.g. AUD.

sender_details.description: Sender; omitted = the account's pickup address.

tools.name: starshipit_update_order
tools.title: Update an order's details
tools.description: WRITE: change details of ONE UNSHIPPED order by order_id (the order is read first and refused if it is already printed or shipped): addresses, shipping method/carrier/service, items, packages, reference or an internal note. This tool never sends status or manifest flags. It does not print a label or buy postage. Items/packages: include item_id / package_id (from starshipit_get_order with include=Items,Packages) to modify an existing line; a line without an id may be added. Nothing is deleted. Send only the fields you want to change. PUT /api/orders.

packaging_type.description: e.g. Carton, Box, Envelope, Jiffy, Pallet, Satchel, Bag.

tools.name: starshipit_add_order_tags
tools.title: Add tags to an order
tools.description: WRITE: add up to 10 tags to ONE UNSHIPPED order (read first; refused if printed or shipped) (a tag that does not exist yet is created). Tags are used for filtering and can drive the account's automation rules. Adding a tag the order already has changes nothing. Tags are not removed. POST /api/tags/order.
